newsitem.title: FINLAND: US volatility drags Helsinki but builders strong.
newsitem.headline: US volatility drags Helsinki but builders strong.

text.p: Shares fell on profit-taking on Wednesday as heavy swings in U.S. stocks and bonds overnight spread wariness, but they crept off lows before the close as U.S. blue chips opened higher, brokers said.

The general HEX index fell 1.42 percent to 2,697.03 as decliners beat advancers by 56 to 37, with 22 issues unchanged. Volume was a moderate 590 million markka, with 44 percent in bourse engine Nokia.
Nokia fell 8.50 markka to 304.50 despite news of a 350 million markka Chinese GSM network expansion order and reports that brokerage Aros rated it a better investment than its Swedish rival Ericsson.
Interest in telecoms was subdued, brokers said.
Insurer Pohjola which has been strong recently fell three percent or 4.50 markka to close at 142.50 as investors took profits in lively dealings.

Construction stocks defied weak sentiment, particularly Starckjohann which hit a two-year high of 8.70 markka, up 0.40 markka or almost five percent, but ended heavy trade slightly off at 8.59 markka.
Brokers said Starkjohann was popular among speculators since its unit price is low, making small movements relatively large.

Lift-maker Kone caused no reaction with its announcement of a Chinese joint venture which targets producing 1,000 lifts and 500 escalotors per year in five years, ending modest dealings flat at 525.00 markka.
